name: [🧲] Collect Coins
desc:
⚡ COLLECT COINS ⚡
Become the ULTIMATE Coin Collector!

Grab your magnet and start your coin empire! Pull massive amounts of coins, unlock legendary pets, and dominate the leaderboards! 💰

🔥 HOW TO PLAY: 
🧲 COLLECT: Use your Magnet to gather Coins around the map! 
💵 UPGRADE: Unlock stronger magnets and boost your collection speed!
⚡ MULTIPLIER MADNESS - Stack boosts to become unstoppable!
🐾 RARE PETS: Find pets around the map which give you multipliers, can you collect them all?
🖥️ AFK: Collect Coins while AFK

👍 LIKE for more updates!⭐ FAVORITE to never miss new content! JOIN the coin collector community!

[Early Access] - Found a bug? Drop feedback and help us make the game even better!

scripts.title: Auto
scripts.script:
setclipboard("https://discord.gg/TR3quUFgT6")

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local Root = Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local ActiveCoins = game:GetService("Workspace"):WaitForChild("ActiveCoins")

local AutoCoins = false

local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://sirius.menu/rayfield"))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "coin farm",
    LoadingTitle = "coin farm",
    LoadingSubtitle = "by Metal on Scriptblox"
})

local Tab = Window:CreateTab("main", 4483362458)

Tab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "auto coins",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        AutoCoins = Value

        if AutoCoins then
            task.spawn(function()
                while AutoCoins do
                    for _,coin in pairs(ActiveCoins:GetChildren()) do
                        if not AutoCoins then break end
                        if coin:IsA("BasePart") then
                            local tween = TweenService:Create(
                                Root,
                                TweenInfo.new(0.05, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),
                                {CFrame = coin.CFrame}
                            )
                            tween:Play()
                            tween.Completed:Wait()
                        end
                    end
                    task.wait()
                end
            end)
        end
    end
})
